blocks.text: CITY OF SAN JOSE DEL MONTE, Bulacan — A couple operating a pet crematorium and their worker have been charged before the City of San Jose del Monte Prosecutor’s Office over the dumping of 25 dead pets in the city last week. The three suspects were identified following an investigation by the San Jose del Monte police. The couple surrendered to the National Bureau of Investigation on Thursday (Nov. 5), according to Police Col. Nelson Sardin, city police chief, on Friday (Nov. 6).
